name: Toritama Citizens' Assembly About Clean Air
content: Problems and Purpose The local government was considering how to ensure the benefit of industrial laundries for employment is met with care for the environment through finding ways to reduce pollution from them. Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Toritama City Hall funded and commissioned the citizens' assembly. Delibera Brasil was responsible for delivering the assembly. Participant Recruitment and Selection 40 participants took part. Methods and Tools UsedCitizens' assemblyWhat Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation Influence, Outcomes, and Effects Recommendations were included in a Citizen Recommendations Report to the Head of City Council and Executive Branch.
